row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Vault API's reference says 'Vault API is based on SCIM 2.0. All SCIM endpoints require a Vault session ID which can be used as Bearer tokens', with no plan or licence restriction stated.
row.notes: Changed from gated to free (judgement call, medium confidence): Veeva has no public pricing or plan tiers, and SCIM 2.0 (/api/{version}/scim/v2: Users, Me, ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes) is part of the standard Vault API with no edition or add-on gate documented. June's 'Vault Enterprise per 18R2' gate and the $50-$200/user industry estimate have no first-party source and were dropped. SCIM has no PATCH, Bulk or Groups; roles via securityProfile. Okta OIN app is SSO only per its text.

plans.name: Vault (per application, quote-based)
plans.price_text: Contact Sales; no public price list or plan tiers
plans.notes: Veeva publishes no pricing page or tier table. SCIM, the Vault REST API and audit-trail endpoints are part of the standard Vault API reference with no plan or licence restriction stated; API calls need a user whose security profile grants API Access.

auth.token_source: Vault session ID (from /api/{version}/auth or an API access token) used as the Bearer token; the user needs the API Access permission

endpoints.notes: Resource types are User and SecurityProfile only; no Group resource. ServiceProviderConfig reports bulk unsupported.

operations.notes: Deactivate/reactivate inferred from the core 'active' attribute being readWrite and PUT accepting any editable attribute. No SCIM DELETE endpoint is documented.

deprovision.notes: Setting active=false via PUT. Outside SCIM, DELETE /api/{version}/objects/users/{user_id} disables (not deletes) the user in one Vault or across the domain.

pagination.notes: count/startIndex; count defaults to 1000 and ServiceProviderConfig reports maxResults 1000.

custom.how: Veeva extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:veevavault:2.0:User carries securityProfile, securityPolicy, licenseType and extendedAttributes (name/value pairs for other user__sys fields such as is_asset_portal_user__sys).

roles.how: securityProfile (required on create) sets the user's Vault security profile; SecurityProfiles is a readable SCIM resource type. licenseType sets the licence (default full__v).

rate_limits.text: Vault-wide burst limit per fixed 5-minute window (example 2,000 requests), then responses are delayed.

limitations.text: No SCIM Group resource; groups must be managed with the non-SCIM groups API.
userName domain must match the Vault, and only the 'work' email type is supported.

capabilities.notes: DELETE /objects/users/{user_id} disables rather than deletes, so delete_user is false. Roles are set through security profile fields.

Update a user's membership in a Vault

okta.notes: OIN overview text says the connector does not support Vault's SCIM endpoint, although the page markup also checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (see conflicts).

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN page text says the Veeva Vault connector does not support Vault's SCIM endpoint, while the same page's capability markup checks SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate.
ServiceProviderConfig example reports filter supported: false, while Retrieve All Users with SCIM documents an eq filter parameter. Recorded the endpoint docs.

open_questions: Whether SCIM or the Vault API carries any licence or edition requirement (no public pricing; June's 'Vault Enterprise per 18R2' claim had no first-party source).
Whether SCIM deactivation frees a licence or ends sessions; no SCIM DELETE documented.
Whether Vault creates users just in time on SSO sign-in (Federated ID mapping only seen).
Whether Veeva Vault is in the Entra gallery, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogues.
